scientific.integrity: The deterministic one-sample AdaLoss update is derived directly from the published loss-value accumulator and applied to a shifted strongly convex quadratic. The result proves both a correctly centered geometric regime and a nonzero-target-error sharp square-root-exponential modal regime with a logarithmic prefactor.
limitations: Finite-dimensional stationary SPD quadratic; deterministic single sample.
Positive optimizer scale, learning-rate, accumulation gain, optimal loss baseline, and target.
Initial scale larger than learning rate times the largest eigenvalue.
Overestimated loss target requires an initial objective gap smaller than the target error.
Trajectory-dependent multiplicative constants are established to exist, not represented as elementary closed forms.

title: AdaLoss has an exact target-error phase transition on strongly convex quadratics
